questions.question: Write three fractions that are equivalent to 2/3 and explain how you made them.
questions.expected_answer: 4/6, 6/9 and 8/12. Each is made by multiplying the numerator and denominator of 2/3 by the same number: 2, 3 and 4.

questions.question: Simplify 18/24 and explain how you know it is in simplest form.
questions.expected_answer: Divide the top and bottom by 6 to get 3/4. It is in simplest form because no number bigger than 1 divides into both 3 and 4.
